notes.title: rTexViewer v4.0 published!
notes.content:
Official release for [u]rTexViewer v4.0[/u]. Some key features on this release:

 - [u]ADDED[/u]: [b]Images shader editor tool[/b]
 - [u]ADDED[/u]: [b]Configuration file[/b] support: [u]config.ini[/u]
 - [u]ADDED[/u]: Support [b]image multi-selection[/b] on board
 - [u]REDESIGNED[/u]: [b]Most input controls for simplicity[/b]
 - [u]REDESIGNED[/u]: Image/board [b]zoom to mouse position[/b]
 - [u]RENAMED[/u]: Directory mode to Folder mode
 - [u]ADDED[/u]: New welcome/about window
 - [u]ADDED[/u]: Support macOS builds (x86_64 + arm64)
 - [u]ADDED[/u]: Improved Linux builds (X11 + Wayland)
 - [u]ADDED[/u]: [b]New grid mode[/b] with configurable spacing
 - [u]ADDED[/u]: [b]New UI style[/b] available: [code single]Amber[/u]
 - [u]UPDATED[/u]: Using raygui 4.5-dev and raylib 5.5-dev
 
Additionally, [b]full code has been refactored for better performance[/b]!

Enjoy [u]rTexViewer[/u]!
